integrity: A self-contained finite checker is provided and verified for all associative quasitrivial tables on at most four elements; finite enumeration is not an infinite proof. The analytic and counting arguments are given in full.
scientific_limitations: The Gaussian law follows from a characteristic-function pole expansion at real Fourier parameters; the extreme upper-tail statement is a logarithmic n log n rate for fixed 0<delta<1/2 only. Established ordered-block classification and total enumeration are credited to prior literature; precise independence of historical discovery has not been verified.
title: Gaussian bulk and giant-block tail of noncommuting pairs in quasitrivial semigroups
